roles.finding: The exact target must distinguish the pre-singularity producer, finite-I ancient limit, and any downstream Liouville consumer. A local pressure/flux observation cannot be promoted to global L3 or backward uniqueness.

roles.background: pressure decomposition, Calderon-Zygmund/local Leray projection and local-energy inequalities
roles.finding: D is a magnitude of pressure oscillation; the local-energy flux is a signed pressure-velocity/transport correlation. Bounding magnitudes does not encode temporal sign. Harmonic/nonlocal pressure remains a separate gluing coordinate.

roles.background: critical scaling, concentration compactness and rigidity
roles.finding: A viable no-recrossing observable must be dimensionless/scale-compatible and survive translation/dilation. A proposed signed flux must also be shown to have one-sided temporal control, not merely be defined.

roles.finding: Pressure-free shear heat flow is an exact smooth NSE calibration showing local energy can enter a ball with p=0. It refutes pressure-alone local one-sidedness only; infinite global energy/finite-I mismatch is an explicit DifferenceWitness.

roles.background: RAKL v3 authority, metrology and research assurance
roles.finding: Prior experience changes route priority only. Episode, diagnosis, failure, obstruction and lesson must remain distinct; shadow TaskEpisode cannot enter canonical inventory or grant promotion.

discussion.topic: Is this a duplicate of B1a1?
discussion.consensus: B1a1 already proves scale-neutrality of absolute local-energy bookkeeping. The new discriminator may retain only a narrower relation: pressure magnitude is not itself the missing no-recrossing coordinate; the missing object must be a signed transport/pressure correlation or another dynamics-specific state. Do not count B1a1 again as novelty.

discussion.topic: Can the shear calibration refute finite-I no-recrossing?
discussion.consensus: No. Its role is a local-PDE falsifier of pressure-alone/local-identity monotonicity. The finite-I/ancient theorem possibility remains open.

Any signed local coordinate must be proved uniform across scale/center, stable under local convergence, compatible with harmonic pressure/far field, and sufficient for a source-valid ancient/global rigidity theorem.

discussion.topic: What route should be next if the ledger fails?
discussion.consensus: Formulate a source-invariant signed flux/correlation candidate only if it gains a one-sided estimate from exact NSE dynamics. Otherwise rotate to another source-valid Liouville trigger. Do not return to saturated geometry/amplitude work while those branches are active.
